attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California Renter's Credit calculation (2025). Non-refundable credit for renters who meet AGI limits. Single/MFS: $60 (AGI limit $50,746). Joint/HOH: $120 (AGI limit $101,492). Must not own property and cannot be claimed as dependent. Source: CA FTB.
